scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Uniqueness of tangent flows at the first singular time of embedded surface mean-curvature flow” (preprints/Tangent-flow-uniqueness-2026-09-24/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 355 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 19b2f77a4cbfb0d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let M0 ⊂ R3 be a smooth compact connected embedded surface without boundary, and let (Mt)0≤t<T be its maximal smooth mean curvature flow. At every singular point (x0, T) at its first singular time there is a smooth properly embedded self-shrinker S such that, as λ → ∞, the full family (1.1) converges locally smoothly in space and with multiplicity one to √ −s S, uniformly for s in compact subintervals of (−∞, 0). The convergence is in the original ambient coordinates, including the axes and position of the limit. Every backward integral Brakke tangent in the stated convention therefore equals the area-measure flow of √ −s S at every negative time.
